chapter 3 Your License to Eat What You Like 
activity 19 recognizing where 
your food rules come from
for you to know
Any food rules that drive your eating had to come from somewhere, because you weren’t born 
with them! Think about where they may have started. Did your family have a lot of rules? Are you 
listening to your friends’ rules? Do you read posts on social media that tell you what to eat, how 
much to eat, or even when to eat?
Perhaps in your family you were told to finish everything on your plate, or you were told that 
you couldn’t have dessert until you finished your meal or only on the weekends. Maybe your 
friends talk about foods they avoid in order to lose weight. Or are you following people who post 
about “clean eating,” or reading about celebrities’ food rules?
for you to do
This worksheet will help you find the source of your food rules. Write a food rule you hold in the 
first column. Then put an X in the column that describes what or who influenced this rule. Con-
tinue with other rules and mark their source. The first row shows Laura’s responses.
